asset_or_action: Apply verified metadata and social preview then publish the pre-release only after tag verification
success_signal: Release page and repository links render correctly
do_not_do: Do not post externally before checking the tagged commit

asset_or_action: Publish the founder LinkedIn post and open the GitHub Discussion
success_signal: Discussion has reproducible feedback template and replies are possible
do_not_do: Do not claim launch numbers or cross-post automatically

asset_or_action: Publish X thread with the audit-gate story
success_signal: Replies identify a concrete question or test case
do_not_do: Do not quote-post strangers for attention

asset_or_action: Publish the 60-second demo with edited-for-time disclosure if applicable
success_signal: Video accurately shows real beta states
do_not_do: Do not simulate a perfect generation

success_signal: Saves or comments ask about a specific workflow step
do_not_do: Do not use engagement pods or invented testimonials

asset_or_action: Review issues and discussion comments then select one reproducible improvement
success_signal: One triaged issue has environment and reproduction details
do_not_do: Do not promise dates for unscoped fixes

asset_or_action: Publish the Reddit post only in a relevant community after reading its rules
success_signal: One substantive critique about setup or writing workflow
do_not_do: Do not repost into unrelated subreddits

asset_or_action: Post one Threads update about the audit gate and a real limitation
do_not_do: Do not repeat the full launch copy

asset_or_action: Publish a GitHub Discussion update summarizing confirmed bugs and limits
success_signal: Reported issues have a visible status
do_not_do: Do not frame unverified feedback as validation

asset_or_action: Invite a narrowly scoped contribution from an existing issue
success_signal: Contributor can identify files and acceptance criteria

asset_or_action: Publish one 30-second short using a different hook
success_signal: Viewers can state what the tool does in their own words
do_not_do: Do not promise that it writes bestsellers

asset_or_action: Submit Show HN only if the repository is usable and the founder can answer technical questions
do_not_do: Do not treat HN as a traffic stunt

asset_or_action: Ship or document the most reproducible fix and link evidence
success_signal: Fix has a regression test or a documented reason not to change

asset_or_action: Write a transparent beta update with what was learned and the next test
success_signal: Next experiment has a measurable question
do_not_do: Do not invent retention conversion or user counts
